name: prometheus.exporter.azure

arguments.name: metrics
arguments.description: The metrics to scrape from resources.

arguments.name: resource_type
arguments.description: The Azure Resource Type to scrape metrics for.

arguments.name: subscriptions
arguments.description: List of subscriptions to scrape metrics from.

arguments.name: azure_cloud_environment
arguments.description: Name of the cloud environment to connect to.

arguments.name: included_dimensions
arguments.description: List of dimensions to include on the final metrics.

arguments.name: included_resource_tags
arguments.description: List of resource tags to include on the final metrics.

arguments.name: metric_aggregations
arguments.description: Aggregations to apply for the metrics produced.

arguments.name: metric_name_template
arguments.description: Metric template used to expose the metrics.

arguments.name: metric_namespace
arguments.description: Namespace for resource_type which have multiple levels of metrics.

arguments.name: regions
arguments.description: The list of regions for gathering metrics. Gathers metrics for all resources in the subscription. Can’t be used if resource_graph_query_filter is set.

arguments.name: resource_graph_query_filter
arguments.description: The Kusto query filter to apply when searching for resources. Can’t be used if regions is set.

arguments.name: timespan
arguments.description: ISO8601 Duration over which the metrics are being queried.

arguments.name: validate_dimensions
arguments.description: Enable dimension validation in the azure SDK.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
